data.narrative:
Thunder Tiger, a publicly traded Defense & Security company founded by Chun Lin Lai, has raised $22M+ as of 2025. The valuation analysis draws from a fragmented comp universe: 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic. The Defense & Security sector contains 23 same-sector peers overall, though the narrow filters—same-stage, adjacent-stage, similar valuation tier—yielded insufficient overlap for reliable peer-median triangulation.

The peer-median method is not applicable given the scarcity of tightly comparable public and private equivalents at Thunder Tiger's stage and scale. A sector-wide median approach would introduce material distortion across heterogeneous business models, geographies, and technology maturity levels within Defense & Security. The limited public comp set (2 tickers) and the fragmented private peer landscape (8 firms with likely divergent growth profiles and funding rounds) preclude robust multiples-based anchoring.

Without sufficient triangulation data, this valuation lacks quantitative support. A defensible range would require either (1) granular financials from the top private peers to establish revenue or EBITDA multiples, (2) disclosure of Thunder Tiger's own revenues or burn rate, or (3) expansion to broader sector comps with explicit discount/premium justification. The current dataset supports only the observation that Thunder Tiger operates within a sparsely populated public and private peer set, limiting analytical precision.
